plugins.name: motifjs
plugins.description: Teaches Claude to build, modify and debug MotifJS applications (@motifx/core + @motifx/compiler): components, reactivity, JSX bindings, views with or without JSX, router, dependency injection, virtualization and error codes.

plugins.name: motifjs-devtools
plugins.description: Teaches Claude to give a MotifJS package its own section in the MotifJS devtools (@motifx-community/devtools) with registerDevtools: sources, commands, events, panels described as JSON widgets, routes, Performance lanes and reveal. For package authors.
